message_template.subject: Senior Executive Profile | ESG, Corporate Affairs & Government Relations | GCC
message_template.body:
Dear HiringBooster UAE Team,

I am reaching out for consideration across senior mandates handled by HiringBooster UAE, particularly within mining, energy, infrastructure, industrial development and other complex regulated sectors.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. Across more than 12 years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, my leadership scope spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, social performance, compliance coordination, executive communications and strategic stakeholder engagement.

My current mandate places me at the intersection of international investment, government, regulators, communities and large-scale resource development. I am focused on Director, Head and country-facing leadership mandates across ESG and Sustainability, Corporate and External Affairs, Government Relations, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and related functions. I am open to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and wider GCC assignments, including expatriate, residential and rotational structures, with a 30-day notice period.

I have attached my executive CV for consideration. My broader executive profile is available at ragunauthramsaroop.com and linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming mandates where institutional leadership, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution are central to business performance.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
